# Design docs

How the GVK_Derelicts systems are built, one file per system, next to the files they describe. The first lines of each file list the files it `covers`; when one of those files changes after the doc does, the GVK Wiki's status script says so. The standard is in the se-dev-kharak skill (`references/readme-standard.md`).

The old README notes live here. Note numbers are kept because hub issues and tool comments cite them ("README note 46" now means the parent leash doc); numbers are never reused.
